tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
u = u.merge(c[['instance_type','family','vcpu','memory_gib']], on='instance_type')
u['req_vcpu'] = u.vcpu * u.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
u['req_mem'] = u.memory_gib * u.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
def rec(row):
    fam = c[(c.family==row.family) & (c.vcpu>=row.req_vcpu) & (c.memory_gib>=row.req_mem)]
    if fam.empty: return row.instance_type
    return fam.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0].instance_type
u['rec'] = u.apply(rec, axis=1)
print((u.rec != u.instance_type).sum())
